daily_thesis: The July 30 backfill batch turns robotics progress into an execution-contract problem. TurboVLA asks whether a language-conditioned policy can run locally at control-loop speed without centering an LLM. RL2-VLA, CheckVLA, Route-by-Kinematics, and explicit kinematic guidance show that a policy also needs adaptive steering, action-conditioned verification, expert routing, and analytic constraints during the episode. CG-World and ActSWM define the world-model version of the same question: state fields, branch lineage, and action-sensitive futures matter more than plausible videos. BioVLN and HumanCLAW make embodiment measurable through operational face, clearance, body skill, and failure attribution. APRL should use this batch to build per-step ledgers for latency, action consequence, repair trigger, world-state field, and body constraint.

paper_autopsies.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Many VLA systems route visual observations through a large language model before actions, which makes the LLM the central execution interface even for routine manipulation.
paper_autopsies.friction: That pathway spends memory and latency every policy call, making high-frequency local control hard even when the instruction has already specified the manipulation intent.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: For execution-level control, the policy may only need language-conditioned visual features, not open-ended language generation at every action step.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: TurboVLA reformulates the V-to-L-to-A pipeline as direct V+L-to-A fusion with lightweight bidirectional interaction and continuous action chunk prediction.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: Independent visual and instruction encoders exchange information through a compact interaction module, then a decoder emits continuous action chunks without centering an LLM.

decisive_evidence.claim: The paper reports compact local deployment with 0.2B parameters, 0.9 GB inference VRAM, and 31.2 ms policy latency.
The method is framed as a move from LLM-centric VLA to direct visual-instruction fusion for continuous control.
LIBERO results are reported together with parameter count, VRAM, latency, and success rate on a single RTX 4090.
Language conditioning is ablated against no language and task-ID embedding, separating semantic instruction from mere task identity.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If the latency gain disappears on real robot sensing and preprocessing, or if direct fusion loses robustness under compositional instructions, the method is a benchmark-speed win rather than a general VLA interface shift.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Removing the LLM can also remove useful reasoning or recovery behavior. The paper needs failure cases where the fast policy chooses the wrong object or phase.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Treat the VLA pathway as an execution interface: log instruction embedding age, visual token set, action chunk, latency, and failure phase.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The idea transfers to language-conditioned manipulation with stable skill semantics. It is less direct for tasks that require open-ended replanning or dialogue.

paper_autopsies.title: RL2-VLA: Adaptive RL Latent Compositional Steering with Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Inference-time steering often applies one intervention recipe at every step, even when the base policy is already producing good action samples.
paper_autopsies.friction: OOD language or environments can collapse VLA success, but unnecessary steering can also push a good action into a correlated failure mode.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A lightweight RL policy over VLA latents can help only when its intervention is gated by likely failure.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: RL2-VLA composes an offline RL latent policy with the frozen VLA flow at inference time and adapts the intervention through failure detection.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: The method extracts expressive VLA action latents, trains a lightweight RL policy, composes flow velocities, and uses conformal prediction to decide when to steer.

decisive_evidence.claim: The paper highlights OOD drops from 38.2% to 14.2% for unseen language and from 70.2% to 36.0% for unseen environments in cited VLA settings.
The tape-in-toolbox real-robot example contrasts rephrasing, non-adaptive RL2, and adaptive RL2 under a collision-prone OOD task.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If the detector fires mostly after the failure is already unrecoverable, adaptive steering becomes a post-hoc explanation rather than a repair mechanism.

paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: For every intervention, store base action sample diversity, latent steering magnitude, failure probability, and whether the repair was necessary.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: This transfers to flow-matching or latent-action VLAs with accessible internal latents. It is weaker for black-box policies without a stable action manifold.

paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Long-horizon VLA policies often commit action chunks and keep executing after a deviation, because commit-time confidence cannot see post-dispatch drift.
paper_autopsies.friction: Observation-only anomaly detection cannot tell the difference between expected consequences of the action and unexplained changes that require intervention.

paper_autopsies.title: CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Video and robotics datasets often expose observations but hide intermediate state, branch metadata, contact events, and production provenance.
paper_autopsies.friction: A world model cannot learn intervention or counterfactual structure if the data records only final pixels or partial trajectories.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: Industrial computer graphics pipelines already preserve the typed state variables that world models need but ordinary video datasets discard.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: CG-World turns CG production records into a world-state protocol with states, observations, relations, events, branch lineage, and provenance.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: The dataset aligns temporally indexed segments with multimodal semantics, spatial structure, skeletal/controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters, physics caches, contacts, and render passes.

paper_autopsies.title: ActSWM: Action-Sensitive World Models for Long-Horizon Planning in Open-World Games
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Latent world models can produce plausible future states while becoming insensitive to the different actions a planner is considering.
paper_autopsies.friction: Prediction accuracy alone does not make a world model useful for planning if alternative actions collapse into nearly the same rollout.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A planning-useful latent dynamics model should preserve enough transition information to recover which action caused a local change.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: ActSWM diagnoses context collapse and trains latent rollouts with an action-sensitivity principle and action-readout separation.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: JEPA-based latent prediction, multi-step rollout training, a hinge loss, and a fixed action readout encourage futures for different actions to remain distinguishable.

decisive_evidence.claim: The overview defines context collapse as plausible rollouts that are insensitive to action inputs.
The framework combines latent prediction, multi-step rollout training, action-sensitivity loss, and action readout.

The paper separates context-collapse diagnosis, closed-loop planning, and discriminative action representations.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If action recoverability improves while downstream planning does not, the auxiliary objective may preserve labels but not the right control variables.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Open-world games are useful stress tests but do not guarantee physical contact validity. The same principle needs robot action-space and embodiment checks.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Before using a world model for planning, test whether different candidate actions remain distinguishable in the predicted latent future.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The principle transfers to action-conditioned planning models. It needs adaptation for continuous robot actions and partial observability.

paper_autopsies.title: BioVLN: A Simulation Platform for Visual Language Navigation in Biomedical Laboratories

paper_autopsies.friction: A lab robot must approach the instrument from the operating side while keeping clearance from benches, walls, and nearby equipment.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: The target should be modeled as body, clearance region, and operational face, not as a point object.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: BioVLN builds laboratory scenes and navigation episodes around a three-zone operational envelope for each instrument.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: Designer-authored or procedurally generated scenes flow through asset annotation, navigation mesh generation, episode construction, and safety metrics.

paper_autopsies.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: When a physically embodied VLM fails, success metrics often mix a poor high-level decision with low-level motor or balance failure.
paper_autopsies.friction: Without decoupling, it is unclear whether the VLM selected the wrong action or the controller failed to execute a reasonable command.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: A benchmark can keep real physical consequences while factoring out low-level execution disturbances.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: HumanCLAW lets a harnessed VLM issue atomic skill commands that are translated into sub-second full-body motion under gravity and collision.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: A skill-conditioned generator executes each command in a physics loop and returns the next egocentric observation, isolating action decision quality.

decisive_evidence.claim: The framework positions HumanCLAW between action without a body and embodied action confounded by balance or motor control.
A VLM maps each egocentric observation to a skill call, which becomes a 0.5 second full-body motion chunk.
Skill achievement ratios are reported near unity for walking, turning, side-stepping, stepping back, sitting, and stair climbing with small variance.
The HTML lists verifier, text history, image frames, and mid-level reasoning as ablated components.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If the harnessed skills remove the hard part of embodiment, the benchmark measures symbolic skill sequencing more than physical action intelligence.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Factoring out low-level control is analytically clean but can overstate deployment readiness where balance, contact, and action choice interact.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Separate body-aware decision quality from motor fidelity, then rejoin them only after the failure attribution is clear.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The setup transfers to embodied decision benchmarks. It should not be used alone to claim full robot deployment capability.

cross_paper_decisions.title: S1 - VLA progress is moving inside the execution loop
cross_paper_decisions.facts: TurboVLA removes the LLM execution bottleneck; RL2-VLA gates latent steering by likely failure; CheckVLA verifies action chunks against predicted consequences.
cross_paper_decisions.inference: The shared research decision is to expose the state of the policy while the episode is still repairable.
cross_paper_decisions.decision: APRL should build VLA logs around latency, intervention trigger, action-conditioned prediction, and repair result.

cross_paper_decisions.title: S2 - World models need action-sensitive state, not just convincing futures
cross_paper_decisions.facts: CG-World records typed state and branch metadata, while ActSWM tests whether different actions remain distinguishable in latent rollouts.
cross_paper_decisions.inference: A world model is a planning asset only when it preserves the action variable the planner is choosing.
cross_paper_decisions.decision: APRL should require action recoverability and branch-lineage metadata in world-model evaluation.

cross_paper_decisions.title: S3 - Embodied benchmarks are becoming geometry-of-use benchmarks
cross_paper_decisions.facts: BioVLN types the operational side and clearance of lab instruments; HumanCLAW factors motor control away from body-aware decision quality.
cross_paper_decisions.inference: Embodiment is no longer a generic 3D scene label; it is the set of constraints that make an action usable.
cross_paper_decisions.decision: APRL should add target affordance, clearance, body command, and failure-attribution fields to embodied tasks.

missing_axis.title: Fast policy papers still need natural-failure repair audits
missing_axis.history: Most VLA comparisons report aggregate success or benchmark perturbations.
missing_axis.read: The missing artifact is a public per-step repair ledger showing when the verifier or steering module prevented a real failure.

strategy_board.thesis: Instrument a VLA episode with direct policy latency, latent steering, action-conditioned predicted consequence, calibrated risk, and suffix repair outcome.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Run two manipulation tasks with a baseline VLA and record action chunk latency, base action, failure probability, verifier risk, and repair decision.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Compare direct fast VLA, adaptive latent steering, and action-conditioned verification under the same induced and natural failure set.
strategy_board.success_metric: At least one evidence field predicts or prevents failure two steps before terminal failure with AUC >= 0.75 or recovery +10p.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If the ledger fields do not improve failure prediction over previous success and task ID, narrow to one failure family.

strategy_board.thesis: Evaluate world models by whether they preserve typed state, branch lineage, and action-distinguishable futures under planning.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Build a small schema for one robot or game trace: state fields, action, observation, branch ID, and action-recovery probe.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Train or adapt a latent predictor and score prediction loss, action recoverability, counterfactual branch consistency, and plan success.
strategy_board.success_metric: Action-recovery accuracy and plan success improve together; if they diverge, identify the missing state variable.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If typed state does not change planning results on two tasks, keep it as dataset documentation rather than a model objective.

strategy_board.thesis: Redefine navigation and embodied decision tasks around usable side, clearance, body skill, and failure attribution instead of reaching a target point.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Annotate ten APRL lab or tabletop goals with physical body, clearance zone, operational face, and required post-arrival action.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Run a small embodied-agent benchmark that reports target success, operational-face success, collision/clearance violation, and body-command attribution.
strategy_board.success_metric: Operational-face success reveals at least one failure hidden by point-goal success; body-command attribution separates decision vs execution failures.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If point-goal success and operational-face success rank methods identically, fold the benchmark into existing navigation tests.
